title: RemoteMessagePayloadV1
description: The plaintext JSON payload encrypted inside an EncryptedEnvelopeV1's ciphertext field. See protocol/README.md for the full specification.

kind.description: The only payload kind version one supports.

text.description: The note text. Must not exceed 2000 Unicode scalar values. The serialized payload (this object as UTF-8 JSON) must not exceed 4096 bytes.

reaction.description: An optional reaction attached to the note.
